Message:
When the hare came to,
she found herself
washed up on a shore.

This wasn’t Heaven,
but rather, an unfamiliar land.

But the black hare,
who had traveled across the world
with the tortoise,
knew there shouldn’t be
any land she couldn’t recognize.

So, where exactly was she...?
After some thought,
the hare realized.

She must have drifted
into another world.

All she had wanted
was to follow after her friends.

“Why am I...
the only one still here...?!”

Everyone and everything
she had cared about was gone,
leaving only the heavy weight of
guilt she felt for surviving.

Raindrops began to fall,
one by one,
and distant thunder
rumbled in the sky.

As if drawn by the sound,
the hare screamed,
her voice nearly
tearing her throat apart.

And to her luck,
her cries were drowned out
by the storm,
reaching not a single soul.
